about: D253 seed questions: roots (s1 total revenue, s2 Data Center revenue, s3 gross margin) and one question per driver class (s4 demand, s5 inputs, s6 share, s7 pricing, s8 product cycle, s9 policy, s10 obligations). Ladders marked copied come from the control run; drafts await the analyst.

questions.question: What will Nvidia's total revenue be in FY2027?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue is at least $500 billion.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue is at least $400 billion and below $500 billion.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue is at least $350 billion and below $400 billion.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue is at least $300 billion and below $350 billion.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue is below $300 billion.

questions.question: What Data Center segment revenue will NVIDIA report for FY2027?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 Data Center revenue is at least $440 billion.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: at least $360 billion and below $440 billion.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: at least $310 billion and below $360 billion.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: at least $260 billion and below $310 billion.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: below $260 billion.

questions.question: What non-GAAP gross margin will NVIDIA report for FY2027?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin is at least 77%.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin is at least 75% but below 77%.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin is at least 73% but below 75%, compared with the article's 75% reference level.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin is at least 71% but below 73%.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: FY2027 non-GAAP gross margin is below 71%.

questions.looks_at: Combined data-center capital expenditures of the four largest AI hyperscalers in calendar 2026
questions.question: How much will the four largest AI hyperscalers spend on data-center capital expenditures in calendar 2026?

rungs.label: Below $550 billion
rungs.condition: Combined spending is less than $550 billion.

rungs.label: $550 billion to below $600 billion
rungs.condition: Combined spending is at least $550 billion and less than $600 billion.

rungs.label: $600 billion to below $700 billion
rungs.condition: Combined spending is at least $600 billion and less than $700 billion.

rungs.label: $700 billion to below $800 billion
rungs.condition: Combined spending is at least $700 billion and less than $800 billion.

rungs.label: $800 billion or more
rungs.condition: Combined spending is at least $800 billion.

key.scope: Combined data-center capital expenditures of the four largest AI hyperscalers

questions.looks_at: Server DRAM and HBM contract prices, calendar 2027 against 2026
questions.question: How will server DRAM and HBM contract prices in calendar 2027 compare with calendar 2026?

rungs.label: Up 30% or more
rungs.condition: 2027 average contract prices at least 30% above 2026.

rungs.label: Up 10% to 30%
rungs.condition: at least 10% and below 30% above 2026.

rungs.label: Flat
rungs.condition: within 10% of 2026 either way.

rungs.label: Down 10% to 30%
rungs.condition: at least 10% and below 30% under 2026.

rungs.label: Down 30% or more
rungs.condition: 30% or more under 2026.

key.scope: server DRAM and HBM contract prices

questions.looks_at: NVIDIA's share of calendar-2026 data-center AI accelerator spending
questions.question: What share of calendar-2026 data-center AI accelerator spending will NVIDIA hold, by the first published full-year estimate?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: share at least 85%.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: at least 78% and below 85%.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: at least 70% and below 78%.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: at least 60% and below 70%.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: below 60%.

key.scope: share of data-center AI accelerator spending

questions.looks_at: Rubin-generation rack price at first volume shipments
questions.question: What will a Rubin-generation NVL72 rack cost a hyperscaler at first volume shipments, by the first published estimate after shipments begin?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: at least $5.0 million per rack.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: at least $4.2 million and below $5.0 million.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: at least $3.6 million and below $4.2 million.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: at least $3.0 million and below $3.6 million.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: below $3.0 million.

questions.looks_at: Whether Nvidia's Rubin generation begins shipping by year-end 2026
questions.question: Will Nvidia begin shipping its Rubin generation by December 31, 2026?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: Nvidia has begun shipping Rubin by December 31, 2026.

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: Nvidia has not begun shipping Rubin by December 31, 2026.

questions.looks_at: China's authorization of imports of Nvidia H200 chips
questions.question: Will Chinese authorities issue any authorization for Chinese companies to import Nvidia H200 chips by January 31, 2027?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: Chinese authorities publicly authorize at least one Chinese company to import Nvidia H200 chips by January 31, 2027.

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: Chinese authorities have not publicly authorized any Chinese company to import Nvidia H200 chips by January 31, 2027.

key.scope: China authorization of Nvidia H200 imports

questions.looks_at: NVIDIA's credit support for AI-cloud capacity
questions.question: What amount of credit-support commitments will NVIDIA report for this programme in its FY2027 annual report?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: Reported commitments are less than $1 billion.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: Reported commitments are at least $1 billion and less than $5 billion.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: Reported commitments are at least $5 billion and less than $10 billion.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: Reported commitments are at least $10 billion and less than $20 billion.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: Reported commitments are at least $20 billion.

key.scope: NVIDIA credit-support commitments for AI-cloud supported capacity
